network.stated_total_quote: The Erasmus+ programme provides students with opportunities for study mobility and traineeships at European and many non-European partner institutions. Algebra Bernays University has signed Erasmus+ agreements with more than 100 higher education institutions across Europe. These partnerships allow our students to organize their learning mobility and benefit from international academic experience.
